name: Crescent Evil Eye Rakhi — Navy & White
shortDescription: A bold crescent-shaped crochet base in navy and white featuring a central protective amulet.
description: A stylish blend of protection and craft. This unique Rakhi showcases a neatly crocheted crescent semi-circle in deep navy blue and crisp white border, holding a classic blue evil eye charm right at its center.

name: Vitthal Rakhumai Rakhi Set
shortDescription: A sacred matching pair of hand-crocheted Rakhis, inspired by the divine presence of Mauli and Rakhumai.
description: Deeply rooted in the faith of the Warkari Sampraday, this beautiful set is dedicated to Vitthal and Rakhumai. It features a vibrant yellow Tilak Rakhi—representing the sacred symbol on Lord Vitthal's forehead—paired with a rich maroon Chandrakor crescent Rakhi.

name: Flower Evil Eye Rakhi — Sky Blue
shortDescription: A delicate sky-blue crochet flower holding a traditional protective evil eye amulet.
description: Combining protection with artisanal charm, this Rakhi features an open-weave crochet flower in soft sky blue, beautifully framing a classic evil eye charm at its center.

name: Star Evil Eye Rakhi — Mustard Yellow
shortDescription: A beautifully textured crochet star in warm mustard yellow featuring a central evil eye.
description: Woven with intricate care, this star-shaped Rakhi comes in a festive mustard shade with a classic protective evil eye accent at the center, completed with a dual-toned twisted thread.

name: Moti Crochet Bracelet Rakhi — Evil Eye
shortDescription: An exquisite hand-crocheted bracelet-style Rakhi featuring a central evil eye medallion flanked by delicate blue-and-white floral accents.
description: Combining protective symbolism with delicate floral craft, this hand-crocheted Rakhi features a central circular evil eye amulet flanked by two tiny crochet flowers in shades of deep blue and white, styled with a sophisticated bracelet band.

name: Moti Crochet Bracelet Rakhi — Forest Green
shortDescription: An elegant, densely braided crochet vine pattern in rich deep green highlighted by tiny pearls.
description: Perfect for brothers who prefer minimal yet sophisticated designs, this Rakhi features a detailed, textured crochet band in deep forest green, punctuated with small white moti (pearl) beads and smooth green glass accents.

name: Moti Crochet Bracelet Rakhi — Terracotta & Ivory
shortDescription: A warm, dual-toned braided crochet Rakhi blending earthy terracotta and soft ivory shades.
description: Capturing the core palette of the season, this Rakhi showcases an intricate, interwoven braided design using warm terracotta orange and ivory cream yarns, dotted with delicate mini moti (pearl) beads.

name: Moti Crochet Bracelet Rakhi — Mint Green
shortDescription: A refreshing, densely woven crochet band in a vibrant mint green with tiny pearl details.
description: A light and cheerful take on our textured band collection, this piece is hand-crocheted in a bright mint green colorway and decorated with neat little white moti (pearl) beads across its length.

name: Moti Crochet Bracelet Rakhi — Red & Brown
shortDescription: An elegant hand-crocheted bracelet-style Rakhi in red and brown with delicate pearl bead accents.
description: Designed with a sophisticated bracelet look, this hand-crocheted Rakhi features rich red and deep brown intertwined threads, accented with lustrous moti details along the edges for a refined and comfortable fit

name: Moti Crochet Bracelet Rakhi — Pink & White
shortDescription: An elegant hand-crocheted bracelet-style Rakhi in pink and white with delicate pearl bead accents
description: Designed with a sophisticated bracelet look, this hand-crocheted Rakhi features beautifully intertwined pink and white threads, accented with lustrous moti details along the edges for a refined and comfortable fit

name: Blossom Shankh Rakhi — Purple & Peach
shortDescription: A layered crochet flower in purple and peach tones holding a sacred miniature Shankh.
description: A beautiful fusion of beach and belief. This Rakhi features a soft, layered crochet flower framing a small, natural white Shankh sourced from the beaches of Bali, tied with a multi-strand cotton thread.

name: Leaf Shankh Rakhi — Herbal Green
shortDescription: An organic, leaf-shaped crochet base framing a sacred miniature white Shankh.
description: Inspired by nature and ritual, this Rakhi features a neatly crocheted leaf medallion in dual shades of green. At its heart sits a tiny, pristine white Shankh from Bali, accented with elegant gold-toned spacers.

name: Classic Flower Rakhi — Deep Red & Mustard
shortDescription: A vibrant, dual-layered crochet flower in rich festive tones of red and mustard yellow.
description: A beautiful color variant of our signature layered floral design. Hand-crocheted petal by petal in pure cotton yarn, combining deep festive red with warm mustard for a traditional touch.

name: Triple Shankh Blossom Rakhi - Pink
shortDescription: A vibrant pink crocheted blossom centerpiece beautifully holding a trio of sacred miniature Shankhs from Bali.
description: Combining coastal beauty with traditional belief, this striking Rakhi features a richly textured, scalloped crochet flower in vibrant pink. At its heart rest three miniature, natural white Shankh shells sourced from the beaches of Bali, accented with pearl and crystal spacers along the band

name: Warkari Tilak Rakhi
shortDescription: A traditional Warkari Tilak-shaped crochet rakhi, inspired by the sacred symbol of Mauli.
description: Deeply rooted in faith, this special rakhi is shaped like the sacred Tilak adorned on Lord Vitthal's forehead. Meticulously hand-crocheted in radiant yellow yarn with a striking black center, dedicated to the spirit of the Warkari Sampraday.

name: Pastel Rainbow Rakhi
shortDescription: A cheerful multi-colored crochet flower blending soft rainbow pastels with a central pearl.
description: A bright and happy twist on our signature layered floral design. Hand-crocheted using a beautifully transitioned multi-colored cotton yarn, featuring soft shades of the rainbow and finished with a prominent central pearl bead.

name: Flower Garland Rakhi — Maroon & Yellow
shortDescription: A festive trio of hand-crocheted flowers arranged like a delicate wrist garland.
description: Inspired by traditional festive torans, this Rakhi features three interconnected crochet flowers in rich maroon and bright mustard yellow, each centered with a neat little pearl accent.

name: Sky Blue Butterfly Rakhi
shortDescription: A whimsical, sky blue crochet butterfly Rakhi accented with delicate pearl beads.
description: Bringing a touch of nature's playful charm to the wrist, this delicate Rakhi features an open-weave crochet butterfly in soft sky blue, beautifully detailed with tiny white beads on the adjustable strings.

name: Circular Evil Eye Rakhi — Beige & Blue
shortDescription: A classic protective evil eye set in a beautifully hand-crocheted circular beige and blue medallion.
description: Handcrafted with love, this Rakhi features a traditional protective evil eye amulet nested at the center of a neat, dual-toned crochet circle in natural beige and vibrant blue. Completed with a soft, twisted matching thread.

name: Pastel Rainbow Rakhi Set (Set of 2)
shortDescription: A matching festive pair of hand-crocheted floral Rakhis in cheerful pastel rainbow tones.
description: Double the handmade love with this set of two. Each Rakhi is beautifully crocheted using soft, multi-colored pastel cotton yarn that transitions smoothly through rainbow hues, finished with a central pearl bead and comfortable, colorful ties.

name: Rosebud Duo Rakhi — Pink & Mauve
shortDescription: A sweet, hand-crocheted duo of pink and mauve rosebuds accented with a tiny green leaf.
description: Delicate and full of handmade charm, this Rakhi features two tiny, hand-stitched rosebuds nestled together with a miniature green leaf. Beautifully framed by tiny white beads on a soft, braided leafy-green band.

name: Blossom Duo Rakhi — Peach & Pink
shortDescription: A sweet, hand-crocheted duo of peach and pink blossoms accented with a tiny green leaf.
description: Delicate and full of handmade charm, this Rakhi features two tiny, five-petal crochet flowers in soft peach and bright pink nestled together with a miniature green leaf. Framed by a white pearl bead on each side of a soft, braided leafy-green band.

name: Ocean Waves Shankh Rakhi — Blue
shortDescription: A serene, hand-crocheted ocean wave design in gradient blues featuring a delicate top Shankh shell.
description: Capturing the calm motion of the sea, this unique Rakhi features tiered crochet ocean waves in shades of deep and sky blue. At the crest of the middle wave rests a tiny natural Shankh shell and a translucent blue bead accent.

name: Pearl Shell Rakhi
shortDescription: An exquisite hand-crafted Rakhi combining natural shell accents and lustrous pearls
description: Featuring a refined blend of coastal charm and festive tradition, this Rakhi incorporates natural shell elements complemented by gleaming pearl details along a comfortable hand-crafted band

name: Bhaiya Bhabhi Rakhi Set
shortDescription: A lovingly curated matching Rakhi set designed especially for Bhaiya and Bhabhi, featuring artisanal crochet details
description: Celebrate the special bond with your brother and sister-in-law with this coordinated Bhaiya Bhabhi Rakhi set. Handcrafted with intricate crochet work and delicate bead accents, this set combines a bold design for the brother with an elegant, bracelet-style Lumba-inspired or matching floral piece for the bhabhi

name: Pastel Flower Rakhi — Blue & White
shortDescription: A charming, dual-layered crochet flower in soft blue and white with a central pearl detail.
description: Hand-crocheted using soft cotton yarn, this Rakhi features a beautiful layered floral pattern in soothing pastel blue and crisp white, complete with a delicate central bead and clean white cotton threads.
